name: Jawed Karim
summary: Jawed Karim, a former PayPal engineer, co-founded YouTube in 2005 with Chad Hurley and Steve Chen and uploaded its first video, "Me at the zoo," on April 23, 2005. He chose to be an informal adviser rather than an employee, so he took a smaller stake when Google bought the company in 2006. He appeared in Fortune's 2007 PayPal Mafia photo.

timeline.role: Co-founder and informal adviser; uploaded the site's first video
